changelog:
Languages, Browser, IR and BLE ADV.

Russian, German, Vietnamese translations improved with extra Russian polish. Thanks to regional users for feedback.

Browser display fixed. System WebView devices update directly. GeckoView devices must update engine pack via Settings → Browser → Render Engine / Engine Pack Management to avoid display issues.

IR Blaster mod: turns Android with IR transmitter into HA infrared emitter via ESPHome native API. Controls TVs, ACs, amps, fans. Supports Xiaomi/Redmi, older Samsung Galaxy S4-S6/Note 3-4, USB-C IR adapters. Path: Mod Store → Devices → IR Blaster (ESPHome).

BLE ADV Proxy mod: connects Ava with ha-ble-adv and esphome-ble_adv_proxy for BLE advertising lights, fans, remotes. Disables built-in Bluetooth proxy to avoid competition. Path: Mod Store → Features → BLE ADV Proxy. Thanks @realroywalker #96.

Sticky Note mod: HA pushes persistent on-screen text with color, size, drag position, one-tap clear. Path: Mod Store → Features → Sticky Note.

Voice Calls from HA: HA can start Ava voice calls, video calls, voice messages directly. Hang up and redial supported. Path: Settings → Interaction → Voice Messages & Calls → Control in Home Assistant. Thanks @deergitseason #101.

Backup & Restore: new page for config copying across tablets. Path: Settings → Experimental → Backup & Restore. Thanks @lorbi.

Custom webrtc-camera fullscreen fixed. Browser download handling added. Phicomm R1 support: LED ring, wake lights, music RGB, top key, 4-mic DOA. Path: Mod Store → Devices → Phicomm R1. Facebook Portal improved: presence detection no longer auto-off after 15s, first-boot wake-word fixed. Thanks @lone-baggie, @deergitseason #100 #104. General stability improved across service init, browser, mDNS, voice channel. Bluetooth RSSI feedback faster.
